tokens.name: bg-app
tokens.usage: Deepest chrome: window background, title bar, status bar, and the 1px gaps that separate docked panels.

tokens.name: bg-viewport
tokens.usage: Empty canvas behind the game in the scene viewport. Never used for chrome.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Body of every docked panel (scene tree, inspector, console). The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panel headers, toolbars, tab strips and collapsible section headers — one step above surface-panel.

tokens.name: surface-input
tokens.usage: Fill of text, number, search and dropdown fields, checkboxes and segmented-control tracks — sunk below the panel.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons, tabs, menu-less list items.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for secondary/ghost buttons; slider and switch tracks at rest.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: Selected row or item while its panel has keyboard focus (ember-tinted).

tokens.name: surface-selected-inactive
tokens.usage: Selected row or item while its panel does NOT have focus.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Floating layers: context menus, dropdown lists, tooltips, toasts, dialogs. Always paired with border-overlay and a shadow token.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers inside a panel: toolbar group separators, list dividers, section edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Resting border of fields, checkboxes, secondary buttons and segmented controls. Meets 3:1 on surface-panel, surface-raised and surface-overlay.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hover border of fields and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-overlay
tokens.usage: 1px edge of floating layers (menus, tooltips, toasts, dialogs).

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Default text and icons. 10:1+ on every surface, including surface-selected.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Property labels, metadata, inactive tabs, idle icons, values left at their code default. 5:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder and empty-slot text ("None (Sprite)"). 5.1:1 on surface-input and 4.8:1 on surface-panel — use it only on those two.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, values and icons. Intentionally below 4.5:1 (WCAG exempts inactive controls).

tokens.name: text-on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and icons on an accent fill (primary button, Play, highlighted menu item). 5:1 on accent, 4.5:1 on accent-hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ember. Primary button fill, Play button, highlighted menu item, checked checkbox and switch. At most one primary button per view.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of accent controls.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Ember as a foreground: active tool icon, active tab indicator, drop-target edges and insertion lines, links, overridden-value marker. 8:1 on surface-panel.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Ember wash behind accent-text: active toggle and segment, drop-target fill, selected device chip.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring (2px, solid). 6:1+ on every surface, so it reads even on surface-selected and accent fills.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success icons and text: console OK lines, status-dot ok, success toast. Always paired with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind success text (badges, banners).

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of a success banner.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning icons and text: console warnings, warning-count badge, warning banner. Always paired with the triangle icon.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning text.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of a warning banner.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors: console errors, invalid field border, "missing" badges and slots. Always paired with the alert-circle icon or a word.

tokens.name: error-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind error text; fill of a missing reference slot.

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of an error banner.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info icons and text, status-dot working, hot-reload progress.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind info text.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge of an info banner.

tokens.name: prefab
tokens.usage: Prefab badge text and prefab node names in the tree. Not a status colour.

tokens.name: prefab-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind the prefab badge.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis: the X label of Vector2 fields and the X handle of the move gizmo.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis: the Y label of Vector2 fields and the Y handle of the move gizmo.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Status dot: idle. Always beside a text label.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the editor behind a modal dialog.

groups.name: UI
groups.note: Inter. 13px is the working size; nothing in the chrome goes below 11px.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles and empty-state titles. The largest text in the chrome.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: tree rows, property labels, menu items, field values that are words.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, active tab, overridden property labels.

styles.name: section
styles.usage: Collapsible section headers in the inspector.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Drag an image here or pick one
styles.usage: Secondary lines: tooltips, banner and toast messages, empty-state explanation, device chips, status bar.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, pills and the state labels in this sheet. Minimum size.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, set one pixel smaller than the UI text so x-heights match.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Numbers in property fields, hex colours, file names in asset slots.

styles.name: mono-console
styles.usage: Console output and stack traces, file paths.

styles.name: mono-small
styles.usage: Counts inside badges, coordinates and fps in the status bar.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Every padding, gap and size is a multiple of 4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, gap between toolbar buttons, padding inside menus.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of rows, fields and ghost buttons; gap between fields in a property editor.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of primary/secondary buttons; padding of banners and toasts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Tree indent per depth level; padding of dialog bodies.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Padding around empty states and dialog edges.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between empty-state icon and the rest; large layout gaps.

radius.note: Small and square-ish: a precision tool, not a consumer app.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, badges, colour swatches, thumbnails in slots.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, tree-row selection, banners, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Context menus, dropdown lists, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs, empty-state icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, pills, switch tracks and knobs.

size.note: Fixed heights of the dense UI. Rows never grow with content.

tokens.name: size-row-tree
tokens.usage: Scene tree and asset list rows.

tokens.name: size-row-property
tokens.usage: Inspector property rows (field inside is size-control-sm).

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Fields, slots and icon buttons inside property rows and panel headers.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, dropdowns, segmented controls, menu items, section headers.

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Main toolbar and viewport toolbar.

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: Panel header and document tab strip.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Window title bar (macOS traffic-light zone).

tokens.name: size-statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar at the bottom of the window.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons in toolbars, panel headers, buttons, menus.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons in tree rows, slots, badges, property rows.

shadow.note: Only floating layers cast a shadow. Panels and controls are flat: 1px borders and fills.

tokens.name: shadow-tooltip
tokens.usage: Tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Context menus, dropdown lists, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring on buttons and standalone controls: 2px of focus-ring outside the edge, following the radius.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-inset
tokens.usage: Focus ring on rows and cells inside scrolling lists, where an outer ring would be clipped.
